failure_modes: Producing large volumes of output nobody will use
Losing the ability to judge quality of the work
gloss: Delegation multiplies reach and removes direct feel for the work
invariants: Tactile feedback decreases as layers increase
mechanism: Each layer of delegation, whether staff or agents, multiplies what one person can accomplish and puts distance between that person and the material. The delegator knows only the handle, not the texture of the thing being moved. Leverage also multiplies the delegator's existing desires and decisions, good or bad.
